limits: Preview runs in the editor WKWebView/browser with per-preview runtime state; a separate native preview window remains under issue14.

HTML/Angular/Tailwind fragments export semantic forms and action metadata; consumers supply navigation/overlay handlers. SwiftUI exports initial @State values, TextField/SecureField and Button onAction callbacks; it does not export a complete multi-artboard runtime. Non-Button SwiftUI prototype callbacks reject explicitly.
Input types are text/password/email, single line, maximum20000 characters; validation, submission, validation-error states, checkbox/select and richer state machines remain in issues12/24.

Authored initial values are saved as document data and appear in exported source; use mock data. Runtime edits remain session-local and reset on preview restart/reset. Canvas and SVG mask password display.

Web reduced-motion is automated. Native keyboard/focus and secure AX masking were inspected in the actual app; native reduced-motion behavior uses the same media query but OS preference switching was not performed. Full VoiceOver acceptance remains issue21.
Preview responds to edits/deleted targets on the author document; it retains form values by stable input ID and discards them when the preview ends or document changes.
